title: Shopify app opportunity for a Remix + Polaris developer
subtitle: Where merchants already pay and the top apps are badly rated, repriced or shutting down: Stocky refugees, Shopify's Retail Barcode Labels, and subscription migrations.

founder.skills: Shopify app dev (Remix + Polaris), 2 private client apps

verdict.summary: The pain is real and recent. Shopify shut Stocky on Aug 31 2026, and retailers can't print labels for what they just received on native purchase orders. But at least 8 apps already chase that exact gap, some for free, so a new public app has no opening. Pivot to a fixed-fee migration and receiving/label setup for small POS retailers, built on the new PO Read API, and only productize if 3 or more pay.

opportunities.name: Receive-to-label for Stocky refugees
opportunities.one_liner: Print barcode labels for exactly what was received on a native Shopify PO.
opportunities.why: pain 8: merchants threaten to leave POS or Shopify over Stocky (e2, e5), many authors across App Store and Community (e1-e9). wtp 5: Stocky was bundled with POS Pro (e31), and price ceilings are low: $40 'insulting', nothing over $100 (e20, e21, e22, e23). gap 2: EasyScan already has POs plus unlimited labels at $9.99 with a 5.0 rating (e32). LabelCraft labels transfers (e33), FyreTrail prints only what was delivered (e42), Stockroom is free with labels (e41, e47), and native POs plus Quick count are free (e29, e30). fit 7: the founder's exact stack. reach 7: active Community threads and review pages, but promotion is limited to the Ask and Offer board (e44). build 6: weeks, on a new read-only PO API (e43).

opportunities.name: Better barcode label app
opportunities.why: Retail Barcode Labels is rated 2.3: 293 of its 476 reviews are 1-2 stars, and updates keep breaking layouts (e13-e19). But Shopify itself points merchants to alternatives (e39), those alternatives are free to $7.99 and rated 4.9-5.0, and merchants balk at any monthly fee for labels (e24).

opportunities.name: Subscriptions for Bold / Shopify Subscriptions refugees
opportunities.one_liner: A calmer subscription app for small merchants.
opportunities.why: Migrations double-charge customers (e25-e28), but Appstle (5.0, 9,042), Seal and Loop are loved. Payments edge cases and support load don't fit 20 h/week.

gap.statement: POS Pro retailers who lost Stocky can't print labels for exactly what they just received on a Shopify purchase order, because native POs have no label path and Shopify's Retail Barcode Labels makes them re-add every product by hand.

pains.theme: Stocky shutdown left retail ops without a home
pains.summary: Merchants say POS is 'no longer worth the pain' and call other platforms.

pains.theme: Can't print labels for received PO items
pains.summary: Labels have to be rebuilt by hand after receiving.

pains.theme: Shopify's Retail Barcode Labels breaks workflows
pains.summary: Default and layout changes, duplicate barcodes, English only.

pains.theme: Low price ceiling after a free tool died
pains.summary: They will pay, but expect well under $40-$100/mo.
Bold v2 and Seal break renewals.

competitors.name: Shopify native POs + POS Quick count
competitors.positioning: Create and manage purchase orders in the admin
weaknesses: Quick count is for spot checks (e30)

competitors.name: Stocky (shut down)
competitors.positioning: Inventory management for Shopify POS Pro

competitors.name: EasyScan Inventory & Barcode
competitors.positioning: Create purchase orders and barcodes, forecast and count stock

competitors.name: Retail Barcode Labels (Shopify)
competitors.positioning: Create and print barcode labels for your products

critic.risk: Pain is real but the price anchor is $0: free PO apps with labels already exist.
Channel closed: Community allows app recommendations only on Ask and Offer, and new apps sit at 0 reviews.
Copyable / already copied: at least 5 apps print labels from received quantities.
Shopify could add 'print received items' to its own label app.

critic.rebuttal: No graveyard found. Genie Inventory merged with Doss; the space is crowded, not dead.

critic.risk: No public API for native POs.
critic.rebuttal: PO Read API shipped in 2026-10 (read-only), enough for receive-to-label (e43).

win_plan.positioning: Your Stocky receiving and labels back, set up for your printer, in a week, for a one-time fee.

switching_triggers.trigger: Stocky shutdown and the read-only export window
switching_triggers.move: Fixed-fee migration offer on the Ask and Offer board

switching_triggers.trigger: A Retail Barcode Labels update breaks a label layout

offers: Supplier + PO history import from Stocky CSVs

build_first.feature: Labels for received quantities from a native PO shipment

where_to_find.place: Shopify Community Ask and Offer board
where_to_find.why: The only place app/service offers are allowed (e44)

pricing.rationale: Public app pricing has collapsed to $0-$19. A service gets paid for the setup work that free apps don't do.

validation.experiment: One Ask and Offer listing plus 10 helpful thread answers without links.
steps: Day 1: post the Ask and Offer listing
Day 3: ask 2 past clients for retail referrals

kill_criteria: Every lead says a free app already covers it
